ABC Dinos is an educational game for children. With spectacular results, the game makes it possible to learn letters and improve reading and writing, regardless of each child's learning level.

ENGLISH VOICES
We have incorporated English voices to repeat the literacy activity words and statements. OBJECTIVES
    - Learn to read
    - Visual and auditory memorization
    - Discrimination of vowels and consonants 
    - Discrimination of the letters of the alphabet
    - Improvement of understanding
    - Learn to draw the outline of all the letters of the alphabet (vowels and consonants). 
    - Expand vocabulary with: animals, professions, objects, clothing, nature, etc.
